THE 3-HOUR CURRICULUM
One continuous, single-day flow — beginner-friendly pacing, with room for advanced participants to stretch further.
Hour 1
FOUNDATIONS · EVERYONE
Prompt engineering: role, context, constraints
Choosing the right tool for the task
Verifying output and catching hallucinations
Responsible use and disclosure rules
Hour 2
APPLIED PRACTICE
Spreadsheet data turned into insight
A private assistant grounded in your documents
AI inside Word, Excel and Outlook
Research and document synthesis
Hour 3
BUILD & PRESENT
Build one finished, usable output
Optional no-code automation demo
Participants present their work
Certificates issued on completion
No prerequisites.

Dr. Shiva Sharma
Assistant Professor · Poddar Group of Institutions
Award-winning academic leader and soft-skills expert with a Ph.D. in Management and 15+ years of experience. He negotiated strategic partnerships with 80+ managers at Tripadvisor and represented India twice at the SAARC Youth Festival, earning the title “Most Commendable Orator.” A recognized innovator with two granted patents, he brings the leadership and communication skills that help participants deploy AI tools with confidence.

Meet your instructor

The wider faculty

More of the team who teach your workshop

Dr. Ruchir Saxena

Professor & Head · Poddar Management & Technical Campus

Recognized as an Innovation Ambassador by the Ministry of Education and AICTE. Holds a Ph.D. and is a published author on the societal impact of AI, including “Lawyerless Courtroom” and “Immersive Realms.” With deep expertise in machine learning and computer vision, he helps participants move from basic theory into strategic, high-level AI integration.

Shubhangini Agarwal

Assistant Professor · Poddar International College

Technologist with a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) and a strong foundation in programming, data analytics, and interactive development. Co-authored the chapter “Foundations of AI” in Immersive Realms: Exploring the Landscape of Artificial Intelligence. Her hands-on style breaks down complex technical ideas into accessible learning experiences for every level.

Kritika Dadhich

AI Trainer

Helps students and professionals apply Generative AI, AI tools, and prompt engineering to real-world work. Combines experience across digital marketing, content, and business — including roles with Capri Global Capital Ltd. and GoMechanic — with certifications from Google Digital Garage, Google Analytics Academy, HubSpot Academy, and Accenture/FutureLearn.

Jitaksh Jain

AI Trainer & Creative Strategist · Founder, Eskeewalker Strategies

Leads an AI-driven creative studio focused on Generative AI, visual storytelling, and content creation. Specializes in turning emerging AI capabilities into practical workflows for branding, communication, and creative production, combining strategic thinking with hands-on, real-world application.
